Cager, thank you for the five-star rating. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon.

Kontota Mobile Dog Grooming - Houston

Jessica did a great job. Spot has a number of skin tags and she was careful around them. He is also blind so that takes some extra care that he doesn’t fall off the table. The most extraordinary thing was his feet were caked with dirt from recent rain and our backyard being dug up. She worked hard to get that all removed. We will be using their service again

Today was Myloh’s very first grooming appointment, and Callie was absolutely amazing! I was a little nervous since it was his first time, but she made the experience so easy and comfortable. She was patient, sweet, and took such great care of him.
I absolutely LOVE how his haircut turned out — he looks adorable!  You can tell Callie really cares about the dogs she works with and takes pride in what she does. I’m so happy we found her and will definitely be bringing Myloh back. Thank you, Callie, for making his first grooming experience such a great one!

Kyra was amazing! Not only was she very sweet, she did exactly what was asked for! I notified her prior that my yorkie was a bit sensitive when it came to the ears. However, she managed to leave him handsome and smelling delicious! Would definitely recommend 10/10
Such a wonderful first experience with Callie🥰 We are absolutely in love with how Miklo turned out. She was so sweet and took her time with him. 🐶💕
The service was prompt ,on time,and very kind s…coco look super cuuuutteee! Thank again.
Calli did awesome with Dallas! They are great!
Wonderful service. Responsive and did a fantastic job!

Thank you, Dayana Hernandez! We appreciate your five-star rating and are thrilled you had a great experience. We look forward to welcoming you back.

Kontota Mobile Dog Grooming - Houston

Today was my first time using Kontota Groomers. They were incredible! The scheduling was extremely easy and the availability was great! I was able to schedule an appointment the same week, which was awesome seeing that my dog was desperate for a haircut. Korie, our groomer, did a fantastic job on my dog. She listened to what I wanted and my dog looks perfect! I couldn't be happier. Thank you so much, Korie and everyone at Kontota - we will definitely be back!
Jonathan was amazing!
Overall good experience. My dogs nails we're getting long and she does not like her paws/nails handled. Sarah was very patient with her and saved the nail trim last.

Sarah was wonderful and amazing! I don't think I'll ever take my babies to a groomer place again. She took her time and care with both of my babies. Both of them are nervous nellies, they struggle getting in the car, shaking and stressed at the groomers and leave my car a mess every time they need a groom. Sarah knew exactly how to allow my babies to come to her, wasn't nervous when they barked at her, and she even carried one of my nervous/scared babies into the van! It usually takes them forever to settle down after the groomers, but both my babies went down for naps after. For the attention to detail, them coming to my home, the picture updates during their service, the customer service and my babies not being stressed, the price is 100% worth it. I think we will definitely be returning customers!
Really really good mobile grooming service!! Callie was amazing and very knowledgeable 🙏🏼 …

Our pups always look and smell amazing after their grooming, and it’s clear that Sabrina genuinely loves what she does. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for a groomer who is trustworthy, professional, and wonderful with their pets. We wouldn’t want anyone else taking care of our fur babies! ❤️🐾
Thank you, Alejandro for taking care of Toby's teeth, nails and bath! He's very happy! 😆 Thank you, again 👌 7/17/2025
Great experience!! Would highly recommend Callie! My dog loves her and he always looks fantastic afterwards, and she’s SO nice
Callie was amazing! She did a great job with our nervous poodle and her cut looks perfect. I highly recommend Callie and will be booking again!
Service was timely.  Sent pictures to let me see progress on molly. Very good job  please d with everything

I had a very easy, thoroughly planned experience with Kontota Mobile Grooming. I let them know about the behaviors of my dog, what motivates her through tough situations (i.e., she is very food-driven), the days I would be available for scheduling, and the specific services I was looking for my girl, Snapple. My dog is a senior dog so she is very stuck in her ways and has anxiety over things that she does not enjoy. They were straight-forward about any potential extra fees and cancellation, and responsive to any additional questions I had.

When it came to the day of, Callie was in charge of grooming Snapple, and gave me an ETA during the arrival period. She showed up with a positive attitude, and handled Snapple’s initial barking very well. I felt very comfortable to hand her off to be in the care of someone I didn’t know. During the appointment, Callie sent me a picture of Snapple, and she seemed very calm! By the end, I noticed a huge shift in Snapple’s demeanor around Callie. She was wagging her tail, and calmly pacing around in Callie’s presence. I am really appreciative that Callie worked with Snapple and helped her get the best cleaning.

Snapple has very short hair, and her fur felt so soft and thoroughly cleaned. In addition, she had a great vanilla smell to her. The nails were our biggest issue to deal with, but Callie handled it with precision and ease. I am very thankful because now, Snapple can walk comfortably!!

Thank you again for everything :)

EDIT (8/22) I am happy to write again that Callie at Kontota Mobile Grooming never disappoints. Her services have always been consistent every time I schedule an appointment for Snapple! Snapple gets more relaxed with baths and nail trimming, and she smells so good after. Thank you Callie!
